page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text. Running head at top centre. Page number top right. Marginal note number "8." in the right margin beside the second paragraph. Heading block in the middle of the page. Drop-cap initial G opens the body. Signature-like word "Sunt" at the lower right, a catchword.

main_text.l: est rerum, quarum in ijsdem artibus præcipuus est
usus, naturam, uim atq; effectus, penitus explorare.
Octauo & postremò, Etiamsi neq; in Theolo-
gia, neq; in medicina, neq; in ullo omnino doctrinæ
genere grauiori uersari liberet: tamen ingens uo-
luptas, quam in uniuscuiusque animo suggerit
rerum naturalium cognitio & contemplatio, merito
excitare omnes deberet ad hanc parte philosophiæ
perdiscendam.
Hactenus hæc quasi prolegomena.
PRIMA PARS PHYSI-
CES, de Principijs.
Explana argumentum octo librorum
Aristotelis de Principijs, seu
de Auscultatione
physica.
GEneratim quidem sic habet. Sicut in una-
quaq; disciplina quædam principia seu loci
communes proponuntur, quos
tenere opor-
tet, antequam ad altiora fiat progressus (uidemus
namque in artibus mathematicis, item in Theolo-
gia & Iurisprudentia cæterisq; id fieri) ita in phi-
losophia naturali sunt quidam loci communes scitu
pernecessarij omnibus qui exactè cupiunt aliquan-
do de quarumcunq; rerum naturis disputare. Hi igi-
tur in illis octo libris explicantur.
Sunt

page.notes: The printed drop-cap G is joined to "Eneratim" as "GEneratim". The word "Sunt" at the lower right is a catchword. The marginal note "8." is a bare section number. Some words in the body are faint; "Hi igitur" ends the paragraph and "Sunt" is the catchword for the next page. Line "est rerum" at top is a continuation fragment. Lines near "cupiunt aliquando" are slightly uncertain: the printed text reads "aliquan do" split across the line break, rendered here as "aliquando" with the hyphen absent.
